fact: AFRINIC states its DNS deployment at the Lusaka IXP in Lusaka went live on 2025-12-08, cutting DNS query response time from 23.188 ms to 1.524 ms (about 93.4%), which shows the exchange is operating.
PeeringDB's record of LSK-IX in Lusaka, last updated 2024-08-02, lists 12 peers and 12 connections (10 open peers) with 76G total capacity, all IPv6-ready.

LSKIX's own member registry lists City Channels Cable Network (CCN, AS328817) as a full member that joined in 2025, with a 10 Gbit/s port at LSK-IX in Lusaka (location Infratel) and a route server session.

The operator's own page describes LSK IX in Lusaka as Zambia's neutral, non-profit exchange where ISPs and network operators interconnect, with 14+ networks connected and public peering and route server services running; the page is undated, so its retrieval date 2026-08-29 is used.
Traffic: 2.8 Tbps (peak) at LSK IX on 2026-08-29, as the operator's page states ("2.8 Tbps Peak Traffic Handled"); the page is undated and gives no date for the peak, so the retrieval date is used.
